claims.text: The postmortem in that file is a Report of External Examination, dated 04/19/21 at time 0713, whose stated cause of death is: 'The cause of death of this elderly white male is central nervous system damage caused by self-inflicted gunshot wound to the head.' It records an entrance wound '1 cm above the right ear', 1.5 cm in diameter, whose edges 'have powder burns', and an exit wound of 1.5 cm above the left ear.

claims.text: The same verdict records who did the work: 'Phillip Wacker, Deputy Coroner, conducted the investigation and established the identity of the decedent. A postmortem examination was conducted by Dr. Dan Purtzer, M.D., Pathologist.'

claims.text: No internal examination was performed. Page 2 of the same report reads in full: 'Due to the obvious cause of death, internal examination is not performed.'

claims.text: Shasta County Sheriff-Coroner case C21-0324, a Verdict of Death (without jury), reads: 'In the matter of the death of Mark Edward McCandlish, a 68 year old male. I, Logan Stonehouse, Chief Deputy Coroner, have inquired into the circumstances of his death and do certify that he was declared deceased on the 13th day of April 2021.' It gives the place of death as '1946 Trumpet Drive, Redding, Shasta County, CA', the cause as 'Gunshot wound of head', other significant conditions as 'None', and manner of death as 'Suicide'.
